title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Content Security Detection and Protection Platform
summary: China Telecom claims improved screening of political and ideological content; its reported classification performance does not establish a public-welfare benefit.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: A distilled and instruction-tuned model screens generated material against China Telecom’s political and ideological criteria. The provider reports broad use and approximately 6% false-positive and false-negative rates. Whether this screening capability improves public welfare remains unresolved.
purpose: Assist the provider in screening content against its stated policy criteria.
system: Generative Artificial Intelligence Content Security Detection and Protection Platform

ratings.reason: The provider claims enhanced detection of subtle policy-sensitive content, with approximately 6% false-positive and false-negative rates. Effects on public welfare remain unresolved.

ai_role.statement: A learned language model identifies policy-sensitive expressions beyond simple keyword matching.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 5: Generative Artificial Intelligence Content Security Detection and Protection Platform

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: A telecom AI model screens content against provider policy
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
